description: This file defines the CommandQueue class, which manages the sending and confirmation of commands in a serial communication context. It utilizes a singleton pattern, includes threading for continuous command processing, and handles command retries based on confirmation messages.

classes.name: CommandQueue
classes.description: A singleton class that handles queuing, sending, and confirmation of commands in a serial communication protocol. It runs a dedicated thread to process commands and retries until acknowledgments are received.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds a listener that is notified of command events.

methods.name: sendPendingCommand
methods.description: Fetches the next command from the queue and initiates sending.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command repeatedly until a confirmation is received, handling retries and timeouts.

methods.name: handleConfirmationMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming messages to detect and record command confirmations.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Enqueues a command to be sent, with various overloads allowing different parameters such as timeout and listener.
